rules.title: Prohibition Against Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
rules.requirement: Hoboken landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms that collect and analyze nonpublic competitor information to coordinate, recommend or set rents, lease terms or occupancy levels. If you believe a landlord did this, you or the Division of Housing can bring the violation to the Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.key_value: Fine up to $2,000 or up to 90 days community service

coverage.summary: Every residential dwelling unit (any primary residence) rented in Hoboken, excluding medical/long-term care and detention facilities.

rules.exemptions: Medical/long-term care facilities and detention facilities are excluded from the definition of residential dwelling unit.
rules.penalty: Upon conviction, one or more of: penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5; a fine not exceeding $2,000; community service not exceeding 90 days. Enforced by the Division of Housing or any aggrieved private citizen in Hoboken Municipal Court.
rules.citation: Hoboken Code § 158-2 (ordinance adopted Jul 9, 2025; body heading reads § 154-8)
rules.quoted_span: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
rules.conflict_note: The ordinance title says it adds Section 158-2 to Chapter 158, but the operative section heading reads § 154-8; codified section number should be verified. Effective date is 'immediately upon passage and publication'; adoption date Jul 9, 2025 is used, publication date not stated.

notes: Single ordinance record. Effective date taken as the adoption date (Jul 9, 2025); actual effectiveness depends on publication, whose date is not given. Section numbering discrepancy (158-2 vs 154-8) flagged.
